title: Give the update check's network git commands their own budget, retry a failed fetch, name the command in a timeout
goal: A slow remote no longer makes "Update now" refuse with "Update check timed out."
acceptance: fetch and ls-remote run with a 60 s budget, local git commands with 15 s
A failed git fetch is retried once; other commands run once
A timeout names the command and the budget, e.g. "git fetch from origin did not finish within 60 s."
lifecycleGit retries a failed fetch once and names the command in a timeout
Safety checks unchanged: no credential prompt, bounded output, SHA validation, sanitized reason
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: "Update now" on NERV-01 after the update (real device)
escalation: Touching the live service or the install folder goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25 when opened: one runner, one wrapper, three tests. Not a measurement.
